title: The control-room lane can drive a goal to a CONTRACT-BOUND, criterion-VERIFIED, LANDED state
description:
PREREQUISITE filed by worker-ca28be90 on 2026-09-07 from task-817d893fa1254a4d82d2888af1f87a47 (the Gate 3 Release proof row), whose DoD-5 is unsatisfiable without this. Measurement in that row's comment-196f88ab (probe output), comment-98ba58b4 (probe source) and comment-6023f9fb (gap, symbol by symbol). Global rail 4 clause 2: the capability is absent, so this is a prerequisite production row rather than a narrowed DoD or a mock-backed journey.

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) BY RUNNING THE LANE, NOT BY READING IT.
The control-room Playwright lane (`tests/e2e/control-room/daemon-ports.ts`) seeds with the SHIPPED demo seed. That seed produces a LEGACY Foundation goal. Probe output, verbatim:

  GRAPHS    [{"goalRef":"goal-live-1","run":"run-live-1"}]
  BINDING   goal-live-1 {"ok":false,"code":"COMPILED_CONTRACT_BINDING_ABSENT"}
  CRITERION goal-live-1 {"ok":false,"code":"COMPILED_CONTRACT_BINDING_ABSENT","layer":"CRITERION_EVIDENCE"}
  DOSSIER   goal-live-1 NULL

`demo-seed-payloads.ts` drives `planning.create_draft`/`ready`/`claim`/`finalize_submission` (:143,:150,:161,:209) and has ZERO `product_contract` hits, so it never reaches `runSubmitDecomposition`, which is the only place `compile-dispatcher.ts:290` mints the binding. `goal-approved-execution-scope.ts:31-42` documents this goal shape by name: "The existing Foundation leg has no Product Contract binding". This is by construction and permanent, not a bug.

CONSEQUENCE FOR EVERY CONSUMER, not just the release row: any browser journey needing `/release/read` PRESENT, criterion coverage, `goal.close`'s contract gate, or a dossier is inert on this lane. `goal-release.tsx:90` gates its control on `sha !== null`, so the card renders honest and DISABLED - the dispatch is unreachable from the browser, so even a REFUSED-path journey cannot be written.

WHAT EXISTS AND CAN BE COMPOSED. `tests/e2e/foundation/multi-node-journey.ts:1-17` already drives the exact chain: goal.create_with_source -> product_contract.propose_revision -> product_contract.approve_gate_1 -> planning.submit_decomposition (daemon compiles, seals, MINTS THE BINDING) -> approval.decide_intent; `multi-node-criteria.ts` drives criterion approval plus checks. `multi-node-wire.ts` `daemonWire(origin, operatorCredential)` already takes an arbitrary origin.

WHY IT IS NOT AN IMPORT. Identities are MODULE CONSTANTS bound to the foundation scratch, not parameters: `multi-node-graph-harness.ts:47-66` fixes GOAL_ID, PROJECT_ID="moe-e2e-multi-node", CONTRACT_ID, REVISION_ID, OPERATOR_CREDENTIAL, AGENT_SESSION/HUMAN_SESSION and node keys ALPHA/BETA/OMEGA; `multi-node-wire.ts` fixes CSRF_TOKEN. The control-room lane runs MOE_PROJECT_ID=e2e-proj-<tag>, csrf `e2e-daemon-lane-csrf`, credential `e2e-daemon-lane-credential`, node ref `node-e2e-<tag>` (daemon-ports.ts:70-71,132-155,311), and `createLaneScratch` writes exactly ONE node spec by design.

THE SHAPE OF THE WORK: parameterise the five foundation modules on project/credential/csrf/goal/node identity WITHOUT changing what `tests/e2e/foundation/multi-node-graph.e2e.test.ts` proves (that suite must stay green with its current constants as defaults), then expose ONE control-room helper - a sibling of `lane-landing.ts` - that takes a `DaemonLane` and returns a goal that is contract-bound, criterion-verified and landed. Do NOT hand-seed a criterion graph and do NOT weaken any consumer assertion; a helper that writes store rows directly is fabricated authority and defeats the point.
definitionOfDone: One exported control-room lane helper (a sibling of tests/e2e/control-room/lane-landing.ts) takes a DaemonLane and returns a goal whose readCriterionGoal is ok, whose readReleaseDossierInput is non-null, and whose criteria carry no gaps - every byte of it driven through the daemon's REAL command edges (product_contract.propose_revision, product_contract.approve_gate_1, planning.submit_decomposition, approval.decide_intent, the criterion approval/check chain). Assert the readers' ok/non-null results from the helper's own arm; a store row written directly by the helper is fabricated authority and rejects the row.

The five foundation modules (multi-node-graph-harness.ts, multi-node-journey.ts, multi-node-world.ts, multi-node-wire.ts, multi-node-criteria.ts) are parameterised on project id, operator credential, csrf token, goal id and node identity, with their CURRENT constants as defaults. Proof: `pnpm test:e2e` runs green with its count line quoted and tests/e2e/foundation/multi-node-graph.e2e.test.ts named in the output - unchanged behaviour, not merely unchanged source.

The lane can LAND on the contract-bound goal: the helper composes with landLaneNode (or states in its own comment exactly why it cannot and what it does instead), and a real sha is asserted with /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/. A goal that is contract-bound but unlandable satisfies nothing downstream, because release.decide is gated on the landed commit (affordance-planning-offers.ts:293).

A committed arm proves the negative that motivated this row: on the SHIPPED-seed lane readCriterionGoal refuses exactly COMPILED_CONTRACT_BINDING_ABSENT at layer CRITERION_EVIDENCE, and on the helper's goal it is ok. Assert the refusal CODE and its LAYER, not merely that one failed and one did not (global rail 1).

Gates quoted with count lines, each run standalone and foreground: `pnpm test:e2e` (names the multi-node spec), `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test:e2e:browser` under the browser-e2e-gate lease with its SPEC COUNT quoted. An exit-0 leg with no count line ran nothing (global rail 8).
taskRails: DO NOT HAND-SEED. Every durable fact this helper produces is driven through a shipped command kind over the daemon's real HTTP edge. A helper that writes store rows or synthesises a binding is fabricated authority and defeats every consumer that depends on it.

THE FOUNDATION SUITE MUST STAY GREEN AND MUST STAY AS STRONG. Parameterising is a defaults-preserving refactor; if a foundation assertion has to weaken to make a constant a parameter, stop and split instead.
PARAMETERISE, DO NOT FORK. A copied multi-node harness under tests/e2e/control-room/ is a second authority that will drift from the one the foundation suite proves.
